add.name: Nahom Insurance and Tax
add.description: The business advertises English and Amharic support for tax preparation and insurance. Professional credentials and individual suitability have not been independently checked.

add.name: E&D International Auto Repair & Alignment
add.address: 3800 S Four Mile Run Dr, Suite F
add.description: An Arlington repair shop offering maintenance, diagnostics and alignment. A published customer account identifies an Ethiopian community connection; ownership background is not independently confirmed by Habesha Hub.

add.name: YOAL Cleaning Service
add.description: The business profile advertises routine, deep, move-in/move-out and office cleaning, with English and Amharic communication. Contact through the linked profile; service area, insurance and availability need confirmation.
add.descriptionAm: የንግዱ መገለጫ መደበኛ፣ ጥልቅ፣ የመግቢያ/መውጫ እና የቢሮ ጽዳትን በእንግሊዝኛና በአማርኛ ግንኙነት ያስታውቃል። በአገናኙ በኩል ያግኙ፤ የአገልግሎት አካባቢ፣ ኢንሹራንስ እና ክፍት ጊዜ ማረጋገጥ ያስፈልጋል።

add.name: Enterprise Development Group (EDG)
add.subcategory: Tax assistance and business training; Amharic resources
add.description: EDG describes tax assistance for eligible low-income residents in the DC area and business education resources, including Amharic media. Contact EDG for current eligibility and schedules; the directory does not arrange loans or tax advice.
add.descriptionAm: EDG በDC አካባቢ ላሉ ብቁ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ላላቸው ነዋሪዎች የግብር ድጋፍ እና የንግድ ትምህርት መረጃ፣ የአማርኛ ሚዲያንም ጨምሮ፣ እንዳለው ይገልጻል። የአሁኑን ብቁነት እና መርሃ ግብር ከEDG ጋር ያረጋግጡ።
